title: DAY PORTER Haverhill MA
excerpt: Day porters are responsible for making sure a company facility looks neat and presentable…
aboutUs:
Glaring Building Maintenance is a rapidly growing, privately owned, and operated, non-franchise company with extensive experience in the commercial cleaning industry.

We have the commitment to our clients to provide them adequate solutions for their specific needs, we specialize in each area that we serve in order to provide them with the best quality.

As an employee of Glaring Building Maintenance, you will have the opportunity to enjoy a career in a supportive family atmosphere.

We offer many benefits and incentives to our staff members, and we are looking for someone honest, committed, and with great enthusiasm to be part of our exceptional transcend team.
jobDescription: Day porters are responsible for making sure a company facility looks neat and presentable to the public, performing routine cleaning tasks such as trash removal, dust removal, vacuuming, mopping, restroom cleaning, and others, depending on the assigned position.
duties: Vacuuming & mopping floors.
Pick up trash and clean trash barrels.
Wash walls and partitions.
Clean and disinfect toilet and toilet seats, dispensers, sinks.
Carry out heavy cleaning tasks and special projects.
Stock and maintain supply rooms.
Cooperate with the rest of the staff.
Ensure compliance with the company's policies and operational guidelines.
Follow all proper safety procedures.
Other duties as required.
requirements: Minimum one year of cleaning experience preferred but we are willing to train the right candidate.
Must be able to pass a criminal background check.
Must be authorized to work in the United States.
Must be detailed oriented.
Able to lift 25 lbs.
Ability to read, write and communicate in English sufficiently to perform the key duties of the position

title: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE Haverhill MA
excerpt: Responsible for providing service recommendations and estimates…
aboutUs:
Glaring Building Maintenance is a rapidly growing, privately owned, and operated, non-franchise company with extensive experience in the commercial cleaning industry.

We have the commitment to our clients to provide them adequate solutions for their specific needs, we specialize in each area that we serve in order to provide them with the best quality.

As an employee of Glaring Building Maintenance, you will have the opportunity to enjoy a career in a supportive family atmosphere.

We offer many benefits and incentives to our staff members, and we are looking for someone honest, committed, and with great enthusiasm to be part of our exceptional transcend team.
jobDescription:
*Face-to-face business development role

Responsible for providing service recommendations and estimates on commercial cleaning industry utilizing a tablet computer and the most advanced presentation and estimating technologies available in the industry, must drive to visit potential clients, reach the goals of calls per day, advance the territory to include development of local business partnerships and organizational affiliations and local enhancement of Glaring Cleaning Services positioning and brand.

A typical workday consists of going to the main office twice a week to complete administrative tasks, meeting with the rest of the sales team and area manager, then driving to visit commercial buildings in your operation area.
duties: Generation of new leads with targeted businesses through various prospecting activities, including cold calling, canvassing, customer referrals and partner relationships.
Assess and qualify potential customers.
Network to sell business to consumer to build a strong customer base.
Introduce customers to new products and services.
Research and analyze new customers and new opportunities.
Identify and prioritize target accounts and individuals (i.e., being resourceful to identify opportunities for Glaring Cleaning Services).
Follow up on opportunities to sell Glaring Cleaning services that come from referrals, marketing campaigns, networking, and industry events.
Support with the continuous development and evolution of the GCS strategy.
Attend meetings, conferences, and events to promote Glaring Cleaning services, as required.
Maintain quality sales records and preparation of sales and activity reports as required.
Responsible for Customer Satisfaction and supporting a positive impression of the Glaring Cleaning Services Experience
Other duties as required.
requirements: Experience in the cleaning industry Sales is a PLUS
Bachelor's degree or equivalent level of professional experience.
Valid Driver's License and satisfactory driving record
Must be able to pass a criminal background check.
Must be authorized to work in the United States.
Must be detailed oriented.
Must have the ability to multitask
Able to lift 25 lbs.
Strong Sales and Customer Service skills.
High proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
The ability to learn quickly and work efficiently as productivity goals are met.
Good organizational skills as this position requires working with multiple departments and following up with clients and prospects.
Must have reliable transportation at time of hire.
Must be able to travel 50% – 75%
Must have 4 years field sales experience
Proven record of accomplishment of sales achievements.
benefits: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.

title: ASSISTANT SUPERVISOR NH
excerpt: Provide support to the supervisor in daily tasks of the assigned accounts…
aboutUs:
Glaring Building Maintenance is a rapidly growing, privately owned, and operated, non-franchise company with extensive experience in the commercial cleaning industry.

We have the commitment to our clients to provide them adequate solutions for their specific needs, we specialize in each area that we serve in order to provide them with the best quality.

As an employee of Glaring Building Maintenance, you will have the opportunity to enjoy a career in a supportive family atmosphere.

We offer many benefits and incentives to our staff members, and we are looking for someone honest, committed, and with great enthusiasm to be part of our exceptional transcend team.
jobDescription:
Provide support to the supervisor in daily tasks of the assigned accounts, cover for employee absence or open positions by performing routine cleaning tasks such as trash removal, dust removal, vacuuming, mopping, restroom cleaning, and others, provide support to project staff if needed ( Waxing floors, Carpet Cleaning and others ) train new and current employees in their assigned duties Also, the Assistant Supervisor must drive to visit those accounts that were assigned to ensure that each account is cleaned according to our quality standards through regular inspections using a tablet computer.

A typical workday consists in having a virtual meeting with your supervisor to coordinate the work of the day and then driving to job sites in your operation area.
duties: Perform regular inspections of the premises to ensure that the scope of work has been achieved.
Maintain inventory control of equipment and chemicals used in assigned accounts.
Cover for employee absence or open positions by performing routine cleaning tasks.
Ensures the scope of work and cleaning expectations are being met by training new and current employees in their assigned duties.
Ensure compliance with the company's policies and operational guidelines.
Follow all proper safety procedures.
Other duties as required.
requirements: Minimum one year of cleaning experience preferred but we are willing to train the right candidate.
Valid Driver's License
Must be able to pass a criminal background check.
Must be authorized to work in the United States.
Must be detailed oriented.
Able to lift 35 lbs.
High School degree preferred
Ability to read, write and communicate in Spanish sufficiently to perform the key duties of the position
benefits: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.

Responsible for coordinating and ensuring the operations of the assigned accounts. Also, the Area Supervisor must drive to visit those accounts that were assigned to him to ensure that each account is cleaned according to our quality standards through regular inspections using a tablet computer.

A typical workday consists of going to the main office to complete administrative tasks, ensure arrival of each employee at the workplace and then driving to visit job sites in your operation area.

Ensure compliance with the company's policies and operational guidelines.
Hiring/Firing for your assigned accounts.
Follow all proper safety procedures.
Other duties as required.
